answer.answer: The accident-insurance programme abbreviated PMSBY is the Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana [E01]. The outcomes that trigger its cover are: death or disability on account of an accident [E01]. Specifically, the cover provides: Rs. 2 Lakhs on death to the nominee [E01]; Rs. 2 Lakhs for total and irrecoverable loss of both eyes or loss of use of both hands or feet or loss of sight of one eye and loss of use of hand or foot [E01]; and Rs. 1 Lakh for total and irrecoverable loss of sight of one eye or loss of use of one hand or foot [E01].

claim_to_evidence.claim: PMSBY is the Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
It is an accident insurance scheme offering accidental death and disability cover
On death, the nominee receives Rs. 2 Lakhs
For total and irrecoverable loss of both eyes or loss of use of both hands or feet or loss of sight of one eye and loss of use of hand or foot, subscriber gets Rs. 2 Lakhs
For total and irrecoverable loss of sight of one eye or loss of use of one hand or foot, subscriber gets Rs. 1 Lakh
